    1. setFactoryCreators(DataFactory)

Class Accessors

Object
Accessors
public abstract class Accessors extends Object
Non-instantiable class that supplies creator functions of datamodel classes to the DataFactory. Constructors of datamodel classes are protected (only visible in this package).

Since DataFactory is outside the datamodel package, it must be provided with creator functions that construct datamodel objects. Class implements a variation of the "Friend Accessor Pattern",
